document_api_meta.title: Reject Return
document_api_meta.env_desc: Use this API to reject a buyer's refund-only, return-and-refund, or replacement request, or to offer a partial refund after the package is received. The valid decision depends on the current request type and status. Before calling this API, make sure the request is still awaiting the seller action that matches the decision you send.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: idempotency_key
request_query_param.desc: A unique value generated by the client that the server uses to recognize repeated requests. Generate a collision-resistant value, such as a UUID, and reuse the same value when retrying the same request. If omitted, the server generates a key for the request; callers that need idempotent retries should provide and reuse their own key. Maximum length: 255 characters.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: decision
request_body_param.desc:
Seller's decision for the request, available values:
- `REJECT_REFUND`: seller reject a refund-only request
- `REJECT_RETURN`: seller reject the initial return-and-refund request
- `REJECT_RECEIVED_PACKAGE`: seller reject return-and-refund request after the buyer has already shipped or handed over the item.
- `REJECT_REPLACEMENT`: seller reject replacement request
- `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`: seller offer partial refund regarding to the package item quality check

request_body_param.name: reject_reason
request_body_param.desc: Seller's reason for rejecting the aftersales request. For `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`, first call Get Review Decision (`GET /return_refund/202606/review_decision`) for the same aftersales request: pass this request's `return_id` as `return_or_cancel_id` and set `check_decisions` to `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`. In the response, select the `data.line_items[]` entry for the affected return line item, then select its `decisions[]` entry whose `decision` is `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`, and submit one of that decision's `available_reject_reasons[].name` values in this field. For other decisions, use the [Get Decision Eligibility](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/69844a11eeba77049695c7f6) endpoint to retrieve the currently available rejection options for the same request and submit the returned rejection reason name. **Note**: Available decisions and rejection reasons depend on the current request status, so retrieve eligibility again before calling this API.

request_body_param.name: comment
request_body_param.desc: Seller's comment about the rejection decision. For `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`, the comment must not exceed 500 characters.

request_body_param.name: images
request_body_param.desc: Images provided by the seller to support the decision. For `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`, a maximum of 6 images is allowed.

request_body_param.name: ^image_id
request_body_param.desc: Image URI obtained from the [Upload Product Image](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509df95defece02be598a22) API.

request_body_param.name: partial_refund_amount
request_body_param.desc: Partial refund amount and currency. Required when `decision` is `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`.

request_body_param.name: ^partial_refund_total
request_body_param.desc: Partial refund amount. When `decision` is `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`, this field is required and must be a numeric string representing an amount greater than 0.

request_body_param.name: ^currency
request_body_param.desc: Currency of the partial refund amount. When `decision` is `OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG`, this field is required and must match the return order's currency.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
